record.question: How do the selected trailheads connect to lakes, passes and each other?
record.reason: The eight western approaches from Crabtree, Gianelli, Bell Meadow and six northern approaches are joined by five bounded southern/eastern approaches: Box Springs–Chain Lakes, Bourland mapped terminus, Shingle Springs–Kibbie/Huckleberry and Leavitt Lake–PCT junction. Bourland continuation, Kennedy parking/branch geometry, southern display gaps, deeper lake/pass branches, returns and individual facility spurs remain unresolved; no wilderness-wide route completeness is claimed.
